# Forge

> Financial models as plain text: a YAML file of inputs, formulas and tables, calculated the same way every time by one Rust engine (203 Excel-style functions, Monte Carlo, scenarios, break-even, decision trees, game theory). It runs as the `forge` command, as an MCP server for AI agents (`forge mcp`), and in the browser (Forge Studio). It is newer than any model's training: read these pages, not memory.

Install: `curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mollendorff-ai/forge/main/install.sh | sh`, or `cargo install mollendorff-forge`. Every command is `forge <command> <file.yaml>`; `forge --help` lists them.

## Start here

- [The guide](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mollendorff-ai/forge/main/docs/guide/README.md): six lessons on one model, each command run by a test
- [Forge with an AI](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mollendorff-ai/forge/main/docs/guide/ai.md): the MCP server in a client, rules for an agent
- [The agent skill](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mollendorff-ai/forge/main/skills/forge-modelling/SKILL.md): how to build, change and check a model, step by step
- [The MCP server](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mollendorff-ai/forge/main/docs/MCP.md): its tools and how to configure a client
- [Models checked on every pull request](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mollendorff-ai/forge/main/docs/guide/pipeline.md): `forge validate` as a gate in GitHub Actions

- [Glossary](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mollendorff-ai/forge/main/docs/GLOSSARY.md)
- [Embedding Forge](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mollendorff-ai/forge/main/docs/EMBEDDING.md): as a Rust crate or in WebAssembly
